Protection | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedures P1, to be performed every six months 
bases as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The 
purpose of the relay is basically to give an indication that under frequency 
occurs into the generator, this protection is used to protect synchronous 
generators and prime mover. Which give alarm signal for 49.0 hz for 1.5 second 
delay & trip signal for 48.0 hz for 3.0 second delay, the feeding of this device 
from voltage transformers on its unit
The first fraft of this document is initiated by eng. Baha Saleh from Assiut 
steam power station and tested by eng. Badry Atea, accepted by eng. Abdel Azem Gomaa Hagrasy, 
certified by eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: UEEPC quality control head sector & MPIS 
coordinator, and approved by eng. Hussein Ahmed Mahdy: head sector of Assiut 
Steam PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety ID category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your Safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, safety belt.... etc
